composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate the body first so a missing or blank required field is a 400 before any
# owner is built or saved. It publishes the body for the build step to reuse.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: normalizeTelephone

# Strip non-digits from the telephone and require exactly 10 digits, so the owner is
# built and stored with the normalized value and a bad number is a 400.
normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

# The email is optional; when present it must be a valid address (else a 400) and is
# stored and returned lower-cased.
normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: ensureUniqueTelephone

# Reject a normalized telephone already used by another owner as a 409, before any
# owner is built or saved.
ensureUniqueTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueTelephone
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueHousehold

# Reject a request whose last name and address already belong to another owner (compared
# case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) as a 409, unless the request opts in with
# 'sharesHousehold'. Runs before any owner is built or saved.
ensureUniqueHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

# Reject a request whose city already holds the maximum number of owners as a 409,
# before any owner is built or saved.
ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: resolveRegistrationDate

# Resolve the effective registration date (supplied, else the server's current date) and
# roll a weekend forward to the next business day. Runs before the daily-limit check so
# the limit counts against the adjusted business day this create will land on.
resolveRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveRegistrationDate
  next: ensureDailyLimit

# Reject a create once the maximum number of owners has already been registered on the
# resolved business day (by registrationDate) as a 429, before any owner is built or saved.
ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: applyRegistrationDate

# Stamp the built owner with the resolved business-day registration date, overwriting any
# date the request body mapped in, so the owner is stored and returned with the adjusted day.
applyRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ApplyRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

# Assign the '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' customer code, where NNNN is one more than the current
# number of owners. Runs before save so the code is stored and returned with the owner.
assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipNumber

# Assign the '<customerCode>-M<YY>' membership number, where YY is the last two digits
# of the registration date year. Runs after the customer code and registration date are
# set and before save, so the number is stored and returned with the owner.
assignMembershipNumber:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipNumber
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# When the request opted in with 'sharesHousehold' and existing owners share this last
# name and address, assign the new owner and those members the same stable 'householdId'.
# Runs before save so the id is stored and returned with the owner.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

# Record how many existing owners already share this owner's first and last name
# (case-insensitively). Runs before save so the count excludes the new owner and is
# stored and returned with it.
countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# The save assigns the generated id, so audit here to log the created owner's id,
# customerCode and registrationDate to the AUDIT logger before responding.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets on input; a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise Australian country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's canonical region derived from its city via a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on registration.
              type: string
              example: FRA-0007
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: FRA-0007-M20
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who knowingly share a household (same last name and address, created with 'sharesHousehold'). Assigned to every member of the household; null for owners who do not share one.
              type: string
              example: 3f2504e0-4f89-41d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301
              readOnly: true

              description: The number of existing owners who shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier

              enum:

              example: SILVER
              readOnly: true

              title: Bulk signup warning

              example: false
              readOnly: true

## Summary

I implemented the GOLD membership tier rule: an owner's `membershipTier` becomes `GOLD` when their household (owners sharing the same `householdId`) has 3 or more members after their create; otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules apply.

Following the codebase's established pattern (a point-in-time snapshot stored on the owner at create, like `namesakeCount`, then read by the mapper), the work is spread across small single-responsibility units:

- **`AssignHouseholdSize`** (new function step) — records the household size after this create: existing members sharing the `householdId` plus the new owner (`+1`). Wired into `owners.POST.yml` right after `AssignHousehold` (so the id is assigned/back-filled) and before `SaveOwner`.
- **`Households.memberCount(...)`** (new helper) — counts existing owners carrying a given `householdId`, reusing the shared household grouping utility rather than duplicating iteration logic.
- **`Owner`** — added the persisted `householdSize` field/column (`household_size`) added to all four schema DDLs (hsqldb, h2, postgres, mysql).
- **`OwnerMapper.membershipTier`** — returns GOLD when the stored `householdSize >= 3`, else falls through to the unchanged SILVER/BRONZE logic.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added `GOLD` to the `membershipTier` enum (the `OwnerDto` is generated from this) and updated its description.

For a shared household of three, the members are stamped with sizes 1, 2, 3 as they're created — so the third resolves to GOLD, matching the acceptance test. The full test suite is green.
